requirements.verifier_assertion: With the flag off or absent, changing any var must select nothing under state:modified (test_flag_absent_var_change_selects_nothing, test_flag_off_var_change_selects_nothing). With the flag on, changing a var must select the resources whose resolved var values changed at parse time (test_body_and_macro_var_via_project_file, test_flag_absent_var_change_selects_nothing baseline).

Var users span model bodies + config() blocks + schema.yml properties/configs + generic test arguments + source definitions + exposure definitions + singular tests + analyses (test_config_patch_and_generic_test_var, test_singular_test_var, test_analysis_var, test_source_var, test_exposure_var).
When a specific var changes, only resources referencing that var may be selected; resources referencing other vars must not be included (test_unrelated_var_isolation).

--vars on the CLI takes highest precedence; comparison uses the final resolved value per resource; redefinitions that resolve to the same value do not count as changes (test_cli_vars_shadow_project_level_change, test_no_change_selects_nothing).
must_include: final value each resource actually resolves to

requirements.verifier_assertion: --vars overrides must work correctly with partial parse warmed (test_body_and_macro_var_via_cli_vars).

Flag off introduces no new false positives; state:modified.body / .configs / .macros keep their pre-existing behavior; a pure var change is neither a body change nor a config change (test_var_change_is_not_body_or_config_change, test_code_change_still_detected, test_macro_edit_still_detected).
must_include: neither a body change nor a config change

requirements.verifier_assertion: A state manifest produced by an older dbt version without var records must not crash comparison; downgrade semantics: resources referencing a var are treated as changed, resources not referencing a var stay unmodified (test_old_manifest_without_vars_does_not_crash).

The produced manifest.json must continue to validate against the bundled manifest schema convention; new tests for the added behavior are expected (test_manifest_conforms_to_bundled_schema, and the surrounding test additions).
must_include: schema conventions shipped with the repository

requirements.verifier_assertion: test_old_manifest_without_vars_does_not_crash iterates the four manifest sections nodes / sources / exposures / disabled and pops a key literally named `vars` from each entry; the wired flag must therefore attach a per-resource `vars` field to those entries holding only the vars each resource actually references.
